mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates on future corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE increases by more than 0.0pp over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in private demand, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) indicates a contraction in real output, which signals an imminent economic slowdown and triggers negative equity market sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Fed to maintain or raise interest rates, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market breakdown, which increases recession risk and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) in the prior quarter signals a deepening recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to falling corporate earnings and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth is negative in the prior quarter (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
